description: The twoq agent is designed to ingest file-based data (such as Excel files and PDB files) and web-sourced information (including Wikipedia historical estimates and scientific papers) through browsing or downloads. It executes Python and Biopython code for parsing and computations, such as calculating distances, velocities, and percentages. The agent filters and aggregates data based on specified criteria (like beak lengths and food categories) and outputs formatted numerical results with the required precision and units.

tools.name: FileIO
tools.description: Handles reading and writing of file-based data formats, including Excel and PDB files.

tools.name: WebBrowser
tools.description: Facilitates browsing and downloading of web-sourced information, such as articles and papers.

tools.name: PythonExecutor
tools.description: Executes Python and Biopython code for data parsing and computations.

tools.name: DataParser
tools.description: Parses and processes data from various formats to prepare it for analysis.

tools.name: DataAggregator
tools.description: Aggregates and filters data based on specified criteria to produce meaningful summaries.

tools.name: ResultFormatter
tools.description: Formats numerical results with the required precision and units for output.
